states.description: Broken glass window model is loaded and visible in the scene

states.description: Shoe model is loaded and visible in the scene

states.name: after_check_3
states.description: Glass fragments on the shoe are selectable via click interaction

states.name: after_check_4
states.description: Refractive index measurement tool can be activated and returns a numeric RI value for a selected fragment

states.name: after_check_5
states.description: Chemical composition analysis has been performed, producing element percentages (e.g. SiO2, Na2O, CaO)

states.name: after_check_6

states.name: after_check_7
states.description: Evidence matching comparison has been triggered and a match confidence percentage is displayed

states.name: after_check_9

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["glass","window","multi","asset"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: Broken glass window model is loaded and visible in the scene

transitions.description: Shoe model is loaded and visible in the scene
Glass fragments on the shoe are selectable via click interaction

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); const kws = ["multi","asset","chemistry","039"]; const match = keys.find(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); if (!match) return keys.length > 0; const v = s[match]; if (typeof v === 'object' && v) return typeof (v.x ?? v.y ?? v[0]) !== 'undefined'; return typeof v === 'number'; })()
